payload.exam_content:
The NMIMS online courses examination process is similar for both UG and PG programs. The exams are conducted through an online proctored platform that allows students to appear for the examinations from any corner of the globe; they only need a good internet connection, a laptop, and a working webcam.

The NMIMS online examinations follow an evaluation method of IA + TEE, which stands for Internal Assessment + Term End Examinations.
payload.admission_fee_note: Step 1. Visit the official website of NMIMS CDOE and complete the registration process by paying the admission processing fee.
payload.emi_content: No direct financial assistance available, but scholarships offered. Multiple payment options: Semester-wise (INR 25,000), Annually (INR 47,000), or One-time payment (INR 1,31,000).
payload.admission_steps:
Online BBA Admission Process

The entire NMIMS online BBA admission process is mentioned below to ensure a hassle-free enrolment process for interested students:

  1. Visit the official website of NMIMS CDOE and complete the registration process by paying the admission processing fee.

  2. Select online BBA along with your preferred specialization and start filling out the online application form.

  3. Attach the supporting documents along with the online application form.

  4. Pay the course fee as per your chosen plan.

  5. Submit the application and wait for confirmation.

  6. Once the university verifies your application and documents, a confirmation letter is provided to your registered email.
payload.about_content:
The NMIMS online BBA in finance is a 3 year online bachelor's degree program designed for aspiring financial professionals. The course has a validity of 6 years, making it highly flexible and accessible to students and working professionals. It also includes multiple career services along with a world-class learning environment.

NMIMS online BBA in finance is delivered through a state of the art learning platform with a 24*7 access to e-learning resources. The course equips students with requisite knowledge on the concepts and principles, which will help them to cope with the latest developments in the global competitive world.

The NMIMS Online BBA in Finance helps students develop analytical and financial decision-making skills through its curriculum designed by industry stalwarts that balances business knowledge with practical finance applications. Students can study at their own pace and learn anytime through e-books, recorded lectures, journals, and other learning resources.

reviews.review_text: I had an amazing experience at NMIMS CDOE and my entire academic journey for online BBA was over in just a quick snap. It was really very flexible and convenient for me.
The NMIMS online BBA was quite good and far better than my expectations. However, I was looking for a flexible and less hectic online BBA program and NMIMS offered me exactly what I was looking for.
The faculty members of NMIMS online BBA are really very supportive and helpful. They assisted me in every way possible throughout my academic career.
The fee structure is quite decent for this academic rigor and student support services. I recommend it to others too.

faqs.question: Does the NMIMS Online BBA in Finance cover investment-related concepts?
faqs.answer: Yes, the course includes subjects such as Investment Analysis and Portfolio Management, Financial Institutions & Markets, and Financial Modeling, helping students understand investment and wealth management concepts.

faqs.question: Is this program suitable for students interested in banking careers?
faqs.answer: Yes, the course curriculum provides exposure to banking and financial services concepts, making it relevant for learners interested in careers within banking, financial services, insurance, and related sectors.

faqs.question: What elective courses are covered in the NMIMS online BBA in Finance program?
faqs.answer: Some of the elective courses covered in the NMIMS online BBA in Finance program are Financial Modeling, Corporate Finance, Fundamentals of Taxation, etc.

faqs.question: What is the semester fee for the NMIMS Online BBA in Finance?
faqs.answer: NMIMS Online BBA in Finance per semester fee is INR 25,000 /-.

payload.placement_content:
Online BBA Placement Partners

The NMIMS online BBA does not offer any direct placement assistance to the students. However, it offers access to the alumni portal along with career services, which include targeted assessments, personalized coaching, and professional development tools.

Some of the major career services offered for the NMIMS online BBA program are:

  • Access to job portal
  • One on one personalized guidance/coaching
  • Profile development
  • Practie interviews
  • Cognitive and behavioral skill assessment

Simultaneously, 98% of students enrolled in NMIMS online BBA admit that they have witnessed a positive impact on their careers. The institution has also partnered with multiple MNCs, corporations, and start-ups that actively recruit skilled professionals. Some of the active recruiting partners are as follows:

  • Mindteck
  • RBS
  • Vaya
  • Helix Tech
  • Milkbasket, etc
payload.eligibility_content:
To enroll in the NMIMS online BBA program, interested students are required to fulfil the following eligibility criteria:

The applicants must have completed a 10+2 educational qualification from a recognised board in any discipline.

A minimum of 50% aggregate marks at the 10+2 qualification is mandatory (45% for reserved category students).

Dedicated student success team with ticketing system tool for query resolution

payload.syllabus_content:
The NMIMS online BBA in finance curriculum combines management fundamentals with finance-oriented electives introduced from the fourth semester. Students gain exposure to core management and financial aspects through the course curriculum. The course curriculum is divided into 6 semesters, and each semester includes 6 subjects.

For your assistance, the entire course syllabus is mentioned below:

Year I

Semester I

  • Principles of Management
  • Business Communication
  • Financial Accounting
  • Micro Economics
  • Organisation Behaviour & HRM
  • Essentials of IT

Semester II

  • Cost and Management Accounting
  • Principles of Marketing
  • Operations Research
  • Macro Economics
  • Business Statistics for Decision Making
  • Introduction to Analytics

Year II

Semester III

  • Business and Allied Law
  • Digital Marketing
  • Financial Management
  • Consumer Behaviour
  • International Business & Export Import Management
  • Sales Management

Semester IV

  • Production & Total Quality Management
  • Research Methodology
  • Performance Management System
  • Environment and Disaster Management
  • Retail Management
  • Fundamentals of Taxation

Year III

Semester V

  • Entrepreneurship Management
  • Project
  • Customer Relationship Management
  • Financial Institutions & Markets
  • Corporate Finance
  • Financial Statement Analysis

Semester VI

  • Business Ethics and Corporate Governance
  • Strategic Management
  • Operations and Supply Chain Management
  • Project Management
  • Investment Analysis and Portfolio Management
  • Financial Modeling
